items.a: Designing agent work as an **explicit graph**: **nodes do work, edges route state**.

items.q: What are the three kinds of graphs Blumenfeld names?

items.a: Memory plus **decision traces** of past runs, **linked to your data**.

items.q: What happens when you compile a SKILL.md into a graph?
items.a: The agent follows explicit steps, so **task reward rises** and **smaller models** can do it.

items.q: What was wrong with the free-reasoning loan agent?
items.a: It took **different paths each run** and its confidence scores **weren't calibrated**.
**Hard-rule scripts**, a **typed decision model**, a **human-escalation router** and a report lint loop.

items.q: How much faster did the compiled loan skill run?
items.a: From about **7.5 minutes to 2**, with a **cheap model** instead of a frontier one.

items.q: Why persist every run in the graph?
items.a: For **audit**, **drift tracking** and seeing **which branches never fire**.

items.q: Why store graphs next to the data?
items.a: They become **portable** across runtimes and harnesses.
